name: One ☆ Boku - Faraway so close! ~Onee-chan to Boku~
original_name: ONE☆BOKU Faraway so close！～お姉ちゃんとボク～
source:
The story is set in Komine village where most residents share the Komine surname, fostering a strong sense of family. The protagonist, Komine Kenjirou, comes from a family with roots in this village. His father, the second son of a family of three siblings, left the village to attend university. Kenjirou would visit his extended family during long breaks, but as his father's work became busier, their connection to the village faded. However, after 10 years, prompted by the request of his parents working overseas, Kenjirou returns to the village for a summer visit, involving a visit to the family grave and greetings to the villagers.
In the village, he reunites with four "older sisters" he used to play with in his childhood (these "sisters", while not blood-related, are referred to as "sister-like" figures). They include his stepsister Mitsuru, cousin sisters Natsuko and Akina, and older childhood friend Chiri. 
The game's theme is romance, focusing on the affectionate relationships between Kenjirou and these sister-like characters. The game primarily emphasizes light-hearted and cheerful interactions, with the heroines having maximum likability from the start and a focus on enjoying moments of love and pampering.

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=165741]Getchu[/url] and partially from [url=https://www.mediaclip.jp/docs/game/2007/10/oneboku.html]Mediaclip[/url]]
translation:
故事发生在小峰村，大多数居民都姓小峰，因此有着强烈的一家人意识。主人公小峰健次郎的家族根源也在这里。父亲在三名兄弟姐妹中排行第二，后来为上大学而离开村庄。健次郎过去会在长假期间探望大家族，但随着父亲工作日益繁忙，他们与村庄的联系渐渐淡去。十年后，在海外工作的父母提出请求，健次郎于夏季返回村庄，祭扫家族墓地并向村民问候。
在村里，他与童年时一同玩耍的四位“姐姐”重逢。这些“姐姐”并非全都有血缘关系，而是如同姐姐一般的人：继姐满、表姐夏子与秋奈，以及年长的青梅竹马知里。
本作主题是恋爱，聚焦健次郎与这些姐姐般的角色之间充满爱意的关系。整体以轻松愉快的互动为主，女主人公们从一开始便拥有最高好感度，重点在于享受恋爱与备受宠爱的时光。

[翻译自[url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=165741]Getchu[/url]，部分内容参考[url=https://www.mediaclip.jp/docs/game/2007/10/oneboku.html]Mediaclip[/url]]
